newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock fund flows jump in 3-day period - survey.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock fund flows jump in 3-day period - survey.

text.p: U.S. stock mutual funds recorded estimated industry inflows of $1.92 billion for the three-day period ended April 17 versus outflows of $708 million for the two-day period ended April 14, according to the latest survey from Mutual Fund Trim Tabs.

The fund tracking firm said flows into growth and income funds ballooned to $1.23 billion from inflows of $249 million. Growth funds recorded a reversal to inflows of $337 million from outflows of $335 million, and aggressive growth funds also posted a reversal to inflows of $355 million from outflows of $537 million.

Bond funds also experienced a change in direction to inflows of $329 million from outflows of $712 million. Muni funds had inflows of $251 million versus outflows of $581 million. Corporate/income/global funds had inflows of $154 million versus outflows of $60 million, and flexible/balanced/mixed funds had inflows of $133 million compared with inflows of $11 million.
